editorial:
Ever wonder what it was like to chase fame before the internet existed? You get a front-row seat to that chaos in this funny story set back in 1983. You will follow a group of young, hopeful musicians who are totally unorthodox and just want to make it big in the rock and roll world. The vibe is loud, messy, and full of heart, capturing that specific early 80s energy where big hair and loud guitars were everything. It feels like a throwback to a time when dreaming big was the only thing that mattered, and you will quickly find yourself rooting for these underdogs to find their sound.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the band members; they feel like real friends who actually enjoy playing together. The pacing stays snappy, though a few slow moments in the middle might test your patience. If you love music and awkward comedy, you should definitely give this a go. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to really soak in the colors of the 80s, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a lighthearted ride that just wants you to have a good time.
endingExplained: After a series of failed gigs and arguments, the band finally gets their big break at a massive local showcase. They stop trying to copy their idols and play their own weird style of music, which the crowd actually loves. While they do not become global superstars overnight, they earn a record deal and a level of respect in their hometown. It ends with them loading their gear into a van, ready to hit the road together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s music and underdog stories.
